[bold #D75FFF]◆ EPIC sase-96[/bold #D75FFF]
[dim]  Title: [bold #D7AFFF][/dim]Stop sase test and tooling scratch from exhausting the /tmp tmpfs[/bold #D7AFFF]
[dim]   Goal: [#D7D7AF][/dim]A full `just check` sweep across every sase workspace no longer [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]grows the /tmp tmpfs without bound: pytest scratch lives off tmpfs [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]with bounded retention, per-test scaffolding stops copying [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]multi-megabyte binary assets, ChangeSpec lock and archive siblings [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]stay inside pytest-managed temp trees, production sase temp files [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]are cleaned up, deleting something under /tmp actually reclaims its[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]space, and a regression guard fails the suite if system-temp [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]leakage returns.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]   Path: [#87AFFF][/dim]sase/repos/plans/202607/[bold #87AFFF][/#87AFFF]tmp_space_exhaustion.md[/bold #87AFFF]
[dim]  1 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Move pytest scratch off the /tmp tmpfs and bound its retention[bold black on #FFD75F][/bold #D7AFFF] medium [/bold black on #FFD75F]
    [#AF87FF]basetemp[dim] · [dim][/dim]no dependencies[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]'Move pytest scratch off the /tmp tmpfs and bound its retention' [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]section: point the pytest base temp directory at a per-workspace on-disk[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]cache instead of the shared 32G tmpfs, set an explicit tmp_path [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]retention policy and count, and add a bounded reaper that prunes stale [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]run directories without waiting out pytest's 3-day lock timeout.[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF][/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  2 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Stop copying multi-megabyte PNG assets into every scaffolded [/bold #D7AFFF] [bold black on #FFD75F] medium [/bold black on #FFD75F]
      [bold #D7AFFF]test home[/bold #D7AFFF]
    [#AF87FF]assets[dim] · [dim][/dim]no dependencies[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]'Stop copying multi-megabyte PNG assets into every scaffolded test home'[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]section: find the scaffolding path that installs the sdd and memory [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]directory-map PNGs, and make asset installation skippable or [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]redirectable so each per-test temp home costs kilobytes instead of ~2.3 [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]MB.[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF][/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  3 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Stop leaking ChangeSpec lock and archive siblings into the [/bold #D7AFFF]   [bold black on #FFD75F] medium [/bold black on #FFD75F]
      [bold #D7AFFF]system temp dir[/bold #D7AFFF]
    [#AF87FF]locks[dim] · [dim][/dim]no dependencies[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]'Stop leaking ChangeSpec lock and archive siblings into the system temp [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]dir' section: migrate the test call sites that create ProjectSpec temp [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]files in the default system temp dir onto pytest's tmp_path, so the [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]`.lock`, `-archive`, and `-archive.lock` siblings that sase creates [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]alongside them land inside a directory pytest can collect.[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF][/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  4 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Give production sase temp files a cleanup path[/bold #D7AFFF]                [bold black on #87D7FF] small  [/bold black on #87D7FF]
    [#AF87FF]prodleaks[dim] · [dim][/dim]no dependencies[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]'Give production sase temp files a cleanup path' section: audit the [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]mkstemp/mkdtemp/NamedTemporaryFile call sites in src/sase that land in [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]the default system temp dir and ensure each one removes its artifact on [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]both success and failure.[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF][/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  5 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Stop `rm` from parking deleted /tmp data inside /tmp[/bold #D7AFFF]          [bold black on #87D7FF] small  [/bold black on #87D7FF]
    [#AF87FF]trashenv[dim] · [dim][/dim]no dependencies[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]'Stop `rm` from parking deleted /tmp data inside /tmp' section: change [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]the dotfiles-level `rm`-to-`trash` alias so paths under /tmp and $TMPDIR[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]are deleted outright instead of moved into a trash directory that lives [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]on the same tmpfs, and document the rule for agents.[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF][/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  6 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Regression guard against system-temp leakage[/bold #D7AFFF]                  [bold black on #87D7FF] small  [/bold black on #87D7FF]
    [#AF87FF]guard[dim] · [dim][/dim]after basetemp, assets, locks[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]'Regression guard against system-temp leakage' section: add a [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]session-scoped check that snapshots the system temp directory around a [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]suite run and fails when the suite leaves new entries behind, so the [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]earlier phases cannot silently regress.[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF][/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  7 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]One-time reclamation of stuck space and orphaned dirents[/bold #D7AFFF]      [bold black on #87D7FF] small  [/bold black on #87D7FF]
    [#AF87FF]reclaim[dim] · [dim][/dim]after trashenv[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]'One-time reclamation of stuck space and orphaned dirents' section: [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]behind an explicit user confirmation gate, reclaim the multi-gigabyte [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]trash directory and sweep the orphaned zero-byte lock files and bare [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]temp entries out of /tmp.[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF][/#D7D7AF]
